summary.text: Sheila Coressel is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 83 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Ty Mathews.
A college administrator and member of the Ada Village Council, Coressel said in a Ballotpedia survey that her priorities are affordable healthcare, public education funding and affordability.

paragraphs.text: Sheila Coressel was born in Defiance, Ohio, and graduated from Tinora High School.

She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Akron in 1998, a graduate degree from Oklahoma State University in 2001 and a Ph.D. from Michigan State University in 2014, and her career experience includes working as a college administrator.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Coressel said she grew up in rural Defiance County, studied accounting, and has spent more than 26 years working with college students.
Coressel said in the survey that she was elected to the Ada Village Council in 2019 and re-elected in 2023.
She was the Democratic nominee for Ohio House District 83 in 2024, when Ty Mathews defeated her.
Her 2026 key messages were accessible and affordable healthcare, reinvesting tax dollars in public education rather than private school vouchers, and affordability.
